text.en:
4234
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Revised Administrative Code, and also to examine and
dispose of damaged and unserviceable postage stamps
which may be presented to it by the accountable officers
concerned for disposition. The Committee shall be com-
posed of the following:
A representative of the Auditor General
A post-office inspector designated by the
Director of Posts
The Assistant Superintendent of the Postal
Savings Bank
The Committee shall, at the call of the Chairma, meet
once every quarter in the Bureau of Posts and there
examine, count and make an inventory of all Postal Savings
Bank stamp cards received as depcsits. The stamp cards
shall be destroyed by burning at a place to be designated
by the Auditor General, in the presence of the Committee.
The Committee shall also then and there investigate and
fix the responsibility for the condition of all unserviceable
and damaged postage stamps, stamped envelopes, postal
cards, etc., presented to it for disposition and is hereby
authorized to destroy such part of the property as it finds
unfit for use or sale by burning at a place to be designated
by. the Auditor General, in the presence of the Committee.
The Committee shall report without unnecessary delay
its quarterly transaction in writing to the Auditor Ganeral
and the Director of Posts, the report to be sworm to by
each member of the Committee.
This Order supersedes all previous Orders on the same
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO' EVANGALISTA
Executive Secretary
